opening.argument: The material promotes a flash-loan arbitrage method as a route to free BNB or substantial profit. Its title promises “FREE BNB,” while the tutorial instructs viewers to connect MetaMask during contract deployment and to send gas money to an address. It further ties the loan amount to a required swap-fee payment and directs viewers to deposit another amount when gas fees are insufficient. A reported earning of about 3.2 BNB and displayed wallet balances are presented as apparent results. But the material does not independently establish that the contract caused those balance changes or that viewers would obtain the stated return.
